purpose: Harden the R3 claim provenance validator before it may ever classify a Batch 19 item VERIFIED.
requirements: Build a pure evaluator that consumes a candidate claim matrix plus captured source metadata and returns VERIFIED or HELD without relying on pre-assigned locality_nature, final status, or precomputed outcome fields.

Before any claim matching, require disk SHA-256 equals metadata SHA-256, exact byte length, HTTP 200, is_fetch_failed false, is_soft_404 false, and a non-empty requested URL, final URL and capture timestamp. Any failure must return HELD.

Require a raw UTF-8 span with byte offsets for title, price or benefit, conditions, validity or recurrence, and an explicit offer-to-Da-Nang binding. A footer, generic locator, generic brand identity, image-only text or calendar inference is not valid locality/validity evidence.
Write mutation tests that invoke the same evaluator with an altered price, locality, expiry, source SHA, HTTP status, soft-404 status and duplicate span. Each altered input must return HELD.
The test suite may use recorded R3 leaves and in-memory fixtures; do not refetch, overwrite, remove or alter R3 artifacts.

Keep the truthful R3 result at 0 VERIFIED / 10 HELD unless the hardened evaluator itself, against pre-existing sources, independently proves otherwise. No source acquisition, catalog hydration or promotion belongs to this work order.
Write all R3-R1 outputs to new paths with SHA-256 sidecars and preserve prior receipts append-only.
acceptance_gate: CEO review required; no automatic promotion
